This script analyzes oyster size over time.   

# Set Up    

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
library(purrr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(seacarb)
library(broom)
library(cowplot)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(multcomp)
library(emmeans)
library(car)

conflictRules("dplyr", mask.ok = list(select = TRUE))
```

# Read in files 

Read in files to be reformatted. 
```{r}
#data<-read_csv("data/size/growth_draft.csv")%>%select(!site)%>%select(!image)%>%select(!notes)%>%select(!flag)
#  
#data<-data%>%pivot_wider(names_from="measurement", values_from="value")
#
#write_csv(data, file="data/size/size_alt.csv")
```

Read in data 
```{r}
data<-read_csv("data/size/growth.csv")%>%select(!initials)

data<-data%>%mutate(date=as.factor(date))

metadata<-read_xlsx("data/metadata/experiment_metadata.xlsx")%>%select(!starting_oysters)%>%select(!`20260107_split`)%>%select(!`20260528_subsample_tag`)
```

Join data together. 

```{r}
data<-left_join(data, metadata)
head(data)
```

# Calculate oyster volume 

Calculate volume using equations as an ellipsoid.

```{r}
calc_oyster_volume <- function(length_mm, width_mm, k = 0.21) {
  k * length_mm * (width_mm^2)
}

data$volume.mm3 <- calc_oyster_volume(data$length.mm, data$width.mm)
```

View data. 
```{r}
hist(data$volume.mm3)

data<-data%>%
  filter(volume.mm3<125000)

hist(data$volume.mm3)
```

# Analyze size over time

```{r}
data<-data%>%
  mutate(tag=as.factor(tag))%>%
  mutate(date=as.factor(date))
```

Add days column
```{r}
data<-data%>%
  mutate(days=if_else(date=="20250530", "0", 
                      if_else(date=="20250923", "116", 
                              if_else(date=="20260528", "363", 
                                      if_else(date=="20260814", "441", NA)))))
```


```{r}
plot1a<-data%>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x=date, y=volume.mm3, color=treatment))+
  facet_wrap(~tag, nrow=2)+
  geom_point(position=position_dodge(0.75))+
  geom_smooth(aes(group=treatment))+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("cyan3", "coral"))+
  ylab("Volume (mm3)")+
  xlab("Date")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1)); plot1a
```

```{r}
plot1a<-data%>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x=as.numeric(days), y=volume.mm3, color=treatment))+
  facet_wrap(~tag, nrow=2)+
  geom_point(position=position_dodge(0.75))+
  geom_smooth(aes(group=treatment))+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("cyan3", "coral"))+
  ylab("Volume (mm3)")+
  xlab("Days")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1)); plot1a

ggsave(plot1a, filename="figures/size/tag_size.png", width=18, height=7)
```

We are missing photos of tags 76, 77, 78, and 79 (YC24-099) from the initial time point.

# Analyze growth 

Run a model on final size

```{r}
model<-data%>%
  filter(date=="20260814")%>%
  
  lmer((volume.mm3)^(1/4) ~ family * treatment + (1|tag) + (1|cage), data=.)

anova(model)

qqPlot(residuals(model))
```

Family is significant, treatment effects are not significant.  

Type III Analysis of Variance Table with Satterthwaite's method
                  Sum Sq Mean Sq NumDF   DenDF F value    Pr(>F)    
family           1186.13 131.792     9 12.0788 45.8437 5.809e-08 ***
treatment           0.55   0.550     1  1.9671  0.1913    0.7052    
family:treatment   15.61   1.734     9 12.0788  0.6033    0.7729   

Analyze growth to include date.

Run a model. 

```{r}
model<-data%>%
  
  lmer((volume.mm3)^(1/4) ~ as.factor(days) * family * treatment + (1|tag) + (1|cage), data=.)

summary(model)
anova(model, type=2)

emm <- emmeans(model, ~ as.factor(days) * family * treatment)
pairs(emm, by = c("days", "family"), adjust = "tukey")

qqPlot(residuals(model))
```

There are some interactive effects present between date x family x treatment. But model is rank deficient. Will need to use date as a random effect. 

Type II Analysis of Variance Table with Satterthwaite's method
                                  Sum Sq Mean Sq NumDF   DenDF   F value    Pr(>F)    
as.factor(days)                  25246.4  8415.5     3 3045.25 3766.1173 < 2.2e-16 ***
family                             560.2    62.2     9   15.68   27.8550 5.206e-08 ***
treatment                            0.4     0.4     1    2.21    0.1672    0.7189    
as.factor(days):family            1089.1    41.9    26 3044.29   18.7465 < 2.2e-16 ***
as.factor(days):treatment            6.3     2.1     3 3046.30    0.9408    0.4200    
family:treatment                    13.2     1.5     9   15.70    0.6586    0.7333    
as.factor(days):family:treatment   153.9     5.9    26 3045.06    2.6488 1.142e-05 ***

Run a model with date as a random effect. 

```{r}
model2<-data%>%
  
  lmer((volume.mm3)^(1/4) ~ family * treatment + (1|tag) + (1|cage) + (1|date), data=.)

summary(model2)
anova(model2, type=2)

qqPlot(residuals(model2))
```

Family only, no treatment effects. 

Type II Analysis of Variance Table with Satterthwaite's method
                 Sum Sq Mean Sq NumDF   DenDF F value    Pr(>F)    
family           775.90  86.211     9 14.0930 33.1617 5.888e-08 ***
treatment          0.20   0.202     1  2.1706  0.0776    0.8049    
family:treatment  18.57   2.063     9 13.8639  0.7935    0.6281     

Run not including the initial size. 

```{r}
model2<-data%>%
  filter(!date=="20250531")%>%
  
  lmer((volume.mm3)^(1/4) ~ family * treatment + (1|tag) + (1|cage) + (1|date), data=.)

summary(model2)
anova(model2, type=2)

emm<-emmmultcompemm<-emmeans(model2, ~family)
cld(emm)

qqPlot(residuals(model2))
```

Family only, no treatment effects.
